maddeler.e:
نستعصم (form X)
# نَسْتَعْصِمُ (nastaʕṣimu) /nas.taʕ.sˤi.mu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْصَمَ (istaʕṣama)
# نَسْتَعْصِمَ (nastaʕṣima) /nas.taʕ.sˤi.ma/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْصَمَ (istaʕṣama)
# نَسْتَعْصِمْ (nastaʕṣim) /nas.taʕ.sˤim/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِسْتَعْصَمَ (istaʕṣama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
